definitions.short: Chatsor , the name (thus simply) of two places in Palestine and of one in Arabia
definitions.full: H2674. Chatsor חָצֹר חָצוֺר, proper name, of a location (Lag BN 47 f. ) — ᵐ5 Ασωρ , etc.; 1 a royal city of northern Canaan Josh 11:1 מֶלֶךְחֿ ׳יָבִין , compare 12:19 , and Judg 4:2 , 17 ; 1Sam 12:9 ; Josh 11:10 (twice in verse); 11:11 , 13 ; 19:36 ; 2Kin 15:29 ; חָצֹר 1Kin 9:15 . 2 places in the Negeb : a. Josh 15:23 . b. c. Josh 15:25 חָצוֺר הִיא חֶצְרוֺן וּקְרִיּוֺת חֲדַתָּה וחָצוֺר . 3 חָצוֺר Neh 11:33 a Benjamite town, probably = חָצוֺר בַּעַל q. v. 4 נְבוּכַדְרֶאצַּו֯ר הִכָּה אֲשֶׂר חָצוֺר מַמְלְכוֺת Jer 49:28 , compare 49:30 ; 49:33 , an Arabian locality, see Winer BW Hazor Gf Gie. — ח ׳עֵין Josh 19:37 , see below עַיִן .
